==Description==
'''Rifted Away''' is an emote that could have been obtained at Level 17 of the premium [[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Battle Pass]] track. It was made by c4rpye. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. The player is unable to move while performing the emote or interact with it.

Upon use, a null portal appears behind the player, which will attempt to suck the player into it.

It had a cost of {{GumDrops|400}} or {{Robux|43}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|3,215}} or {{Robux|871}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|54}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{Robux|1,098}}.
